articles.title: COCOLAB™ Named #1 Dentist-Recommended Woven Floss Brand
articles.mainIdea: COCOLAB™ Named #1 Dentist-Recommended Woven Floss Brand
articles.summary: PR Newswire: COCOLAB™ Named #1 Dentist-Recommended Woven Floss Brand. COCOLAB™, the dentist-designed oral wellness brand known for reimagining everyday routines, is proud to announce that it has been named the #1 dentist-recommended woven floss brand.* The designation is based on a recent IQVIA ProVoice survey measuring dentist recommendations within the woven floss category.

articles.title: Tina Posey, CEO of Spinutech, featured on "Dallas CEOs You Should Know" on iHeartMedia Dallas
articles.mainIdea: Tina Posey, CEO of Spinutech, featured on "Dallas CEOs You Should Know" on iHeartMedia Dallas
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Tina Posey, CEO of Spinutech, featured on "Dallas CEOs You Should Know" on iHeartMedia Dallas. Spinutech CEO Tina Posey was recently featured on "Dallas CEOs You Should Know", a business interview series from iHeartMedia Dallas spotlighting influential leaders shaping the future of their industries. The episode aired during Women's History Month, underscoring Posey's impact as a seasoned female executive and champion of people-first leadership.
